title: 第23章 垃圾肉卖出天价第24章 图穷匕见
slug: 我能穿越去修仙你跟我分手
content_zh:
一夜无话。
第二天清晨，天光乍亮，林渊便已收拾妥当，提着食盒，径直来到赵升的院外。
门刚一推开，院中正在活动筋骨的赵升猛地转过身。
林渊脚步一顿，不由得眯起了眼睛。
眼前的赵升，仿佛脱胎换骨。
身形依旧，但整个人的精气神却截然不同。
气息沉稳了许多，举手投足间，灵力波动竟然比昨日强了不止一筹。
“赵师兄，你这是……突破了？”
“哈哈哈哈！”
赵升发出一阵中气十足的大笑，快步走上前来，重重拍了拍林渊的肩膀。
“林师弟！”
“你可真是我的大福星啊！”
他一张脸激动得通红，语速飞快，像是要把积攒多年的情绪一口气全倒出来。
“你那盖浇饭……简直是神物！”
“你刚走，我体内的灵力就跟疯了一样乱窜，差点没把我给撑爆了！”
“我赶紧打坐，结果你猜怎么着？”
“困扰我整整一年零八个月的瓶颈，就这么……咔嚓一下，破了！”
赵升伸出三根手指，声音里带着一丝哭腔。
“你知道我这三年是怎么过的吗？”
“没有丹药，没有灵石，只能靠苦修硬磨！”

“每天赚的那点灵谷，自己都舍不得吃！”
“要不是最近帮你卖玄元饼换了点聚气散还有昨天的那顿饭，我恐怕这辈子都卡死在炼气二层了！”
看着激动得快要手舞足蹈的赵升，林渊笑了笑。
他心里明白，那一顿饭固然灵气充沛，但更重要的，是赵升这近两年的苦修打下了足够深厚的基础。
‘自己那份饭，更像是点燃干柴的火星，成了他厚积薄发的引子。’
“师兄这是苦尽甘来，以后只会越来越强。”
“对对对！”
“以后只会越来越强！”
赵升用力点头，随即又一脸严肃地抓住林渊。
“不说了！”
“正事要紧！”
“今天必须把这神仙饭卖出去，让所有人都尝尝！”
两人来到外门弟子自发形成的坊市广场。
这里早已是人声鼎沸，各种地摊琳琅满目，卖什么的都有。
两人找到管事弟子，缴纳了十颗聚气散作为摊位费，换来了一块最角落、最偏僻，几乎无人问津的位置。
林渊也不在意，从储物袋中取出早已备好的桌椅和一块木牌。
他拿起木炭，在牌子上写下一行大字：
【秘制妖兽肉盖浇饭——火龙爆鳄肉】
【两块下品灵石一份！】
content_en:
A night of silence.
The next morning, when the sky broke out, Lin Yuan had already packed up, carried the food box, and went straight to Zhao Sheng's courtyard.
As soon as the door was opened, Zhao Sheng, who was stretching his muscles in the courtyard, turned around suddenly.
Lin Yuan paused and narrowed his eyes.
The Zhao Sheng in front of him seemed to have been completely transformed.
The body shape is still the same, but the spirit and spirit of the whole person are completely different.
His breath became much calmer, and the fluctuations in his spiritual energy were much stronger than yesterday.
"Senior Brother Zhao, have you... made a breakthrough?"
"Hahahaha!"
Zhao Sheng let out a hearty laugh, walked up quickly, and patted Lin Yuan hard on the shoulder.
"Junior brother Lin!"
"You are really my lucky star!"
His face was flushed with excitement, and he spoke very fast, as if he wanted to pour out all the emotions he had accumulated for many years in one breath.
"Your donburi... is simply a divine thing!"
"As soon as you left, the spiritual energy in my body was running around like crazy, and it almost burst me!"
"I quickly meditated, and guess what?"
"The bottleneck that had been bothering me for a whole year and eight months just... clicked and was broken!"
Zhao Sheng stretched out three fingers, with a hint of crying in his voice.
"Do you know how I have spent these three years?"
"There is no elixir, no spiritual stone, we can only rely on hard training!"
"I can't bear to eat the little spiritual grain I earn every day!"
"If I hadn't helped you sell Xuanyuan cakes in exchange for some Qi Gathering Powder and yesterday's meal, I might have been stuck on the second level of Qi Refining for the rest of my life!"
Looking at Zhao Sheng who was almost dancing with excitement, Lin Yuan smiled.
He knew in his heart that that meal was certainly full of spiritual energy, but more importantly, Zhao Sheng's hard training in the past two years had laid a solid foundation.
‘My share of the meal was more like the sparks that lit the fire, and became the catalyst for his accumulation of wealth. ’
"Senior brother, this is the end of all hardships, and I will only get stronger in the future."
"Yes, yes!"
"It will only get stronger in the future!"
Zhao Sheng nodded vigorously, and then grabbed Lin Yuan with a serious face.
"Stop talking!"
"Business matters!"
"We must sell this fairy rice today so that everyone can have a try!"
The two came to Fangshi Square, which was formed spontaneously by the outer disciples.
The place is already bustling with people, and there are a variety of stalls selling everything.
The two found the disciple in charge and paid ten Qi Gathering Powders as the stall fee, in exchange for a location in the corner, the most remote place that almost no one cared about.
Lin Yuan didn't care and took out the tables, chairs and a wooden sign that had been prepared from the storage bag.
He picked up the charcoal and wrote a line of large characters on the sign:
[Secret Monster Meat Rice Bowl - Fire Dragon Exploded Crocodile Meat]
[Two low-grade spiritual stones for one portion! 】
